text:
Predicates:
Cost(x, y) ::: x costs y dollars.
CheaperThan(x, y) ::: x is cheaper than y.
ProvidesAid(x, y) ::: x provides financial aid to y.
ProveHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
LivesInSingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
HasFewResources(x) ::: x has few resources available.
Applicant(x) ::: x is applying to take the GRE.
Premises:
Cost(greTest, 205) ::: It costs $205 to take the GRE test.
CheaperThan(205, 300) ::: The cost of GRE test is cheaper than $300.
ProvidesAid(ets, y) :- ProveHardship(y) ::: ETS provides aid to those who prove hardship.
LivesInSingleParentFamily(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
HasFewResources(tom) ::: Tom has few resources available.
ProveHardship(tom) :- LivesInSingleParentFamily(tom) ∨ HasFewResources(tom) ::: Tom can prove hardship because he lives in a single-parent family or has few resources.
Applicant(tom) ::: Tom is applying to take the GRE.
Conclusion:
Cost(greTest, 205) ::: It costs $205 to take the GRE test.
